description: POST a JSON array of flat objects (or {"rows":[...]}) and get CSV back. Columns are the union of all keys in order of first appearance. Values are quoted and escaped per RFC 4180. Nested objects are stored as JSON text. Up to 5000 rows per call. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/json-to-csv.
name: json-to-csv
